strings.s: Exports an Antigravity conversation to Markdown and counts tool traffic.
BetterCompact Antigravity - exports an Antigravity conversation to Markdown.
Input: an Antigravity conversation ID or its SQLite file under conversations.
-o: a Markdown file or output folder.
Default output: UserData/Conversations beside the program.
